candidates.change_summary: Change the require statement from 10 ether to 9 ether so the fallback behavior diverges for calls with 10 ether value.
Change block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0 to invert the transfer condition.
Delete the first require statement so fallback no longer enforces msg.value.
Delete the second require statement so timestamp check is removed and pastBlockTime can be set arbitrarily.
Delete the pastBlockTime update so pastBlockTime stays unchanged, altering future fallback eligibility.
Delete the entire if block so no transfer ever occurs, changing the balance behavior after fallback.
Change address(this).balance in the transfer to a fixed amount like 1 wei to diverge transferred value.
Replace the transfer recipient from msg.sender to a constant address to change who receives the funds.
Insert a selfdestruct or revert inside the if block so transfer never happens under the mod 15 condition.
Move pastBlockTime = block.timestamp after the if block so timestamp is only updated when transfer doesn't happen.
